name: KAF WordPress Connector
author: simurdigital

sections.description:
KAF WordPress Connector seamlessly integrates your WordPress website with the KAF AI SEO Assistant platform, enabling fully automated SEO error detection and correction. By leveraging advanced AI capabilities, this plugin ensures your website’s SEO elements are always optimized—without the need for manual intervention.

Key Features:

  • Automatically updates post and page titles and meta descriptions based on AI-driven SEO analysis.
  • Creates new posts and categories directly from the KAF panel.
  • Uploads images to your WordPress media library as recommended by the AI assistant.
  • Reduces human error and saves time by automating repetitive SEO tasks.
  • Improves your website’s search engine visibility and overall SEO health.

KAF WordPress Connector is ideal for website owners, agencies, and SEO professionals who want to maintain optimal SEO performance with minimal effort.

For more information and to create a KAF AI SEO Assistant account, visit KAF AI SEO Assistant.

Author

Developed and maintained by Simur Digital in partnership with KAF AI SEO Assistant
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via the WordPress admin panel or upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/kaf-wordpress-connector directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings page and enter your KAF AI SEO Assistant API key.
  4. Once connected, the plugin will automatically synchronize with your KAF panel and begin optimizing your website.
sections.faq:
Do I need a KAF AI SEO Assistant account to use this plugin?

Yes, an active KAF AI SEO Assistant account and API key are required for the plugin to function.

What SEO elements does the plugin currently support?

The current version supports automatic updates for titles and meta descriptions, creation of new posts and categories, and image uploads. Additional features will be added in future releases.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all communications between your WordPress site and the KAF platform are encrypted and secure.
sections.changelog:
1.4.2

  • Bug fix — REST API kapalı sitelerde bağlantı kurulamıyordu: Bir güvenlik eklentisi veya functions.php kodu WordPress REST API’yi tamamen kapattığında, KAF /wp-json/kaf/ namespace’ine gelen istekler de engelleniyordu. Plugin artık rest_authentication_errors hook’unu en yüksek öncelikle (PHP_INT_MAX) bağlayarak kendi namespace’ini bu engellemeden muaf tutar; site genelinde REST API kapalı kalır, yalnızca KAF endpoint’leri çalışır. E2E test: mu-plugin ile rest_disabled simüle edildi, KAF verify endpoint’i 200 döndürdü, /wp-json/ root’u 403 vermeye devam etti.

1.4.1

  • Bug fix — “Sayfa Düzeltmeleri AKTİF” sahte sinyali: Admin status panelindeki “Aktif Özellikler” kartlarından “Sayfa Düzeltmeleri” ve health endpoint’in features.apply_batch flag’i class_exists('KAF_SEO_Repair_Apply') okuyordu — class plugin boot’unda her zaman load olduğu için sürekli true dönüyordu, SEO Repair kapalıyken bile “AKTİF” görünüyordu. Doğru SSoT olan KAF panel sync’inden gelen kaf_repair_state.enabled‘a bağlandı. SEO Repair açılıp ilk batch koşulduktan sonra panel’den enabled flag’i akar; öncesinde “PASİF” görünür.
  • Bağlantı yokken alt menü gizlendi: Düzeltme Geçmişi / Aktif Kurallar / KAF AI İçerikleri / Kural Değişiklikleri alt menüleri bağlantı kurulmadan da görünüyordu. Bağlanmamış sitede içerik zaten boş; kullanıcı bağlanma kartına yönlendirilirken alt menüler kafa karıştırıcıydı. add_submenu() ilk satırda kaf_connection_code boşsa erken return — bağlantı sonrası tekrar görünür.

1.4.0

  • KAF Website Management (Site Yönetim Modülü): Yeni endpoint grubu kaf/v1/manage/*. KAF panel artık WordPress sitesinin kullanıcılarını listeleyebilir/yönetebilir ve “WP Admin’e Git” şifresiz girişi (HMAC SSO) destekler.
  • One-Click SSO: KAF panelindeki butonla, WordPress yönetici paneline tek kullanımlık imzalı token (HMAC-SHA256 + 60s TTL + nonce replay koruması) ile şifresiz geçiş.
  • WordPress Kullanıcı Yönetimi: Kullanıcıları KAF üzerinden listele (sayfalama + arama + rol özeti), oluştur, rol/email/ad-soyad güncelle, şifre sıfırla (direkt set veya standart “şifremi unuttum” maili), sil (içerikleri başka kullanıcıya devirle).
  • Eklenti & Tema Yönetimi: KAF panelden eklenti ve tema listesi, aktivasyon/pasifleştirme, uzaktan kurulum (wp.org slug veya .zip URL), tek tıkla güncelleme, otomatik güncelleme toggle’ı, sürüm kilitleme (kazara güncellemeyi engelle), 2 yıldan fazla güncellenmemiş eklentiler için “abandoned” tarama.
  • WordPress Çekirdek + Code Snippets: WP/PHP/MySQL sürüm bilgisi + güncelleme önerisi + DB upgrade durumu, tek tıkla WP Core güncelleme, çeviri/dil paketi güncelleme, DB upgrade tetikleme. Code snippets KAF panelden CRUD: syntax validasyonu, scope (global/admin/frontend), aktif snippet’ler plugins_loaded‘da güvenli eval (Throwable yakalanır → snippet otomatik pasifleşir), fatal koruma (shutdown handler).
  • İçerik + Yedekleme: Post/page listesi (sayfalama + arama + status/author filtre + status counts), post status değiştir (publish/draft/pending/private/trash/untrash), bulk delete (trash veya permanent). UpdraftPlus entegrasyonu: yedek geçmişi + son yedek özeti + zamanlı backup’lar + boot_backup() ile manuel tetikleme. UpdraftPlus kurulu değilse BACKUP_PLUGIN_NOT_INSTALLED.
  • KAF AI İçerikleri admin sayfası: WP yönetici panelinde KAF AI tarafından otomatik oluşturulan tüm post’ları (auto-blog yazıları + AI content) tek listede gösteren yeni alt-menü. _kaf_auto_created=1 marker’lı post’lar — durum + tarih + yazar + batch kaynak filtreleriyle.
  • Batch İzleme: Yeni post_meta marker _kaf_batch_id — apply_page_create ile yaratılan post’lar hangi apply-batch’ten geldiğini saklar (auto-seo-blog-XYZ vb.); KAF AI İçerikleri sayfasında “Batch / Kaynak” kolonunda gösterilir.
  • Modüler Yapı: includes/website-management/ alt dizini her özellik için ayrı dosya — sso.php, users.php, plugins.php, themes.php, core.php, snippets.php, content.php, backup.php.

1.3.2

  • Real WP Rollback (T15): Yeni endpoint POST /seo-repair/restore-batch — KAF panelden “Geri Al” tetiklendiğinde post_meta + post_content’teki değişiklikler 7-gün penceresi içinde gerçek WP-tarafında geri alınır (önceden sadece KAF DB güncelleniyordu, WP’ye sinyal gitmiyordu). 9 ana kategori + post_slug + content_body kapsam içinde; Yoast / Rank Math / All in One SEO mirror alanları senkron geri alınır. Rollback idempotent (tek seferlik), 7-gün retention sonrası history entry’leri inline pruning ile düşer.

1.3.0

  • Modern Admin Dashboard: Redesigned settings, history, and policy pages with KAF brand styling and dark mode support; hero panel surfaces total time saved by automation, top categories, top pages, and a 7-day activity sparkline.
  • Mutation History: New “Mutation History” sub-menu lists every applied SEO fix with URL- or category-grouped views, search/filter, before/after diff timeline, and one-click “Edit in WordPress” links.
  • Rollback: Per-mutation revert button restores the previous value — including Yoast / Rank Math / All in One SEO mirror fields where present.
  • Applied Policies Page: New “Applied Policies” sub-menu shows the live configuration of every active server-side policy (indexation, link rel, hreflang, redirects, parse-time filters, image attributes, security headers, custom CSS) for full transparency.
  • Site-Level Mutation Log + Connection Log: Append-only audit trail tracks every change to plugin policy options with before/after snapshots, plus a connection event timeline on the settings card.
  • AI Content & Page Creation: New content_body and page_create apply-batch actions support full post body rewrites (with rotating backup snapshots per post) and AI-generated pages with category, author, featured image, tag, and excerpt support.
  • URL Normalization: New url_redirects apply-batch category — force lowercase, strip trailing ?, strip session IDs, parameter whitelist, dedupe duplicate parameters, and underscore-to-hyphen rewrites (with internal anchor href correction).
  • EEAT, Video & Slug Schemas: New business_info (Organization JSON-LD with PostalAddress + ContactPoint), schemas VideoObject, and post_slug apply-batch categories.
  • Security Headers & Custom CSS: New security_headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options) and custom_css (mobile font-size, tap-target spacing, content overflow overrides) apply-batch categories.
  • Site-Level Autofix: New endpoints automate robots.txt creation/repair, sitemap generation, and missing-sitemap reference patching for site-wide issues.
  • Internationalization: Added Text Domain kaf-wp-connector and Domain Path: /languages for translatable strings.
  • Compatibility Fix: Heading override DOM parser now uses an instanceof DOMElement guard for PHP 8.1+ readiness.

1.2.0

  • KAF SEO Repair Engine (Server-Side Auto-Fix): Batch mutation endpoint applies titles, descriptions, OG tags, canonicals, robots directives, headings, image alts, and JSON-LD schema in a single request.
  • Crawler Bypass Handshake: The plugin now recognizes the KAF audit crawler via a shared project token and skips mutation output so audit scores measure the raw root cause.
  • Parse-Time HTML Filters: Server-side defer injection for external scripts, non-critical CSS preload swap (render-blocking CSS), and mixed-content HTTPS rewrite for same-host assets.
  • Indexation Control: Pattern-based wp_robots filter for tag / pagination / search / filter / per-URL noindex directives.
  • Link Rel Policy: the_content filter adds rel="nofollow noopener" to external links (with domain whitelist) and strips nofollow from internal links; data-kaf-skip="rel" opt-out supported.
  • Hreflang Extensions: Reciprocal hreflang injection with x-default fallback and BCP47 <html lang> normalization.
  • Image Attribute Optimization: fetchpriority="high" for critical attachments and <link rel="preload" as="image"> injection for above-the-fold assets.
  • Redirect Rules: Trailing-slash normalization (with/without) and custom 301 redirect map.
  • Health Endpoint: GET /seo-repair/health returns plugin version (now dynamic), active feature flags, and last-batch metadata for backend observability.
  • Fix: plugin_version in site-info and health responses no longer returns a hardcoded stale value.

1.1.0

  • Enhanced SEO Optimization: Improved the ability to automatically generate and update titles, meta descriptions, and heading tags.
  • Smart Sitemap Management:
    • Added a new sitemap generator tool.
    • Added a new feature to automatically correct errors in existing sitemaps.
    • Added a feature that automatically adds missing URLs on the site to the sitemap.
  • Robot.txt Control:
    • Added a new robot.txt generator and editor tool.
    • Added a new feature to automatically add the sitemap URL if it’s missing from the robot.txt file.
    • Added a feature to automatically remove blocking rules for SEO-critical URLs.
  • Content Update Capability: Added the ability to update page content, which helps improve SEO performance.

1.0.0

  • Initial release: Automated title and description updates, post/category creation, and image uploads.
